title: You can only divide a larger number by a smaller one
statement: In a division the bigger number must be divided by the smaller number, so if the divisor is bigger the two numbers should be swapped.

evidence_patterns.item_shape: divide a fraction by a larger whole number
evidence_patterns.signature: swaps dividend and divisor so that the larger number is divided by the smaller

evidence_patterns.item_shape: write the division for a word problem where the dividend is smaller than the divisor
evidence_patterns.signature: writes the numbers in the order that makes the dividend larger

example.item: 3/4 of a litre is shared equally between 3 people. Write the division.

discriminators.vs_slip: A slip is one reversed pair. The belief is a stated rule ('you can't divide a small number by a big one') and is applied to whole numbers too (3 / 12 rewritten as 12 / 3).

vs.math.frac.divide-makes-smaller: Divide-makes-smaller keeps the order and gets a smaller wrong result; this belief changes the order.

conflicts_with.label: CCSS 6.NS.A.1: interpret and compute quotients of fractions

resolved_by.label: CCSS 6.NS.A.1: interpret and compute quotients of fractions
CCSS 5.NF.B.7: divide unit fractions by whole numbers and whole numbers by unit fractions
